'''Fabrice Brugere''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Ben Con tournament (9 June)]] on 9 June 2001 with @#$% Deck #99 (Dejarik Holotable, senses and alters), according to Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2495">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-21-ben-con-denver-co-6-9-01-gooood-trd2495/ ben-con-denver-co-6-9-01-gooood-tr], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 21 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-21-ben-con-denver-co-6-9-01-gooood-trd2495/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
